# Alpha Omega Strength Team

> Performance apparel for the disciplined. From Alpha to Omega. Faith-rooted athletic wear and a field journal at the intersection of training, scripture, and the discipline of finishing what you start.

Based in Miami, FL. Est. 2026.

## Primary content

- [The Journal](https://aostrengthteam.store/blog): Field journal — faith + fitness essays, training notes, scripture reflections. New entries weekly. RSS feed: https://aostrengthteam.store/blog/rss.xml
- [Shop](https://aostrengthteam.store/shop): Heavyweight tees, long sleeves, and hoodies built for the disciplined.
- [About](https://aostrengthteam.store/about): Brand story, manifesto, and the four pillars — Discipline, Resilience, Integrity, Community.
- [Contact](https://aostrengthteam.store/contact): Get in touch.

## Editorial themes

- Faith-driven training: scripture-rooted reflections on the discipline of fitness
- The Alpha / Omega frame: beginnings, finishes, and the work in between
- Quiet conviction over loud bravado; premium materials over hype

## Voice

Restrained. Encouraging. Scripture-rooted. Never preachy.

## Brand standards

- Author: Pete Fluriach (Founder)
- Editorial cadence: weekly journal entries
- Newsletter: The Weekly Discipline (Sunday mornings)
